Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int hIndex(vector<int>& C) {
        const int len = C.size();
        int i = 0, j = len - 1; // 双指针: i从0扫描到目标结果h时结束, j从len-1扫描到0, 扫描到0时break
        while (C[j] > i)
        {
            i++;
            if (j == 0) break;
            else j--;
        }
        return i;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> C = {1, 3, 2, 2, 5, 2, 3, 7};
    auto res = sol.hIndex(C);
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
